## 1. Summary

12个顺序Step的MP/Repository/CQRS/SS源码与definitions适配已完成；source clean verify、生成工程verify及生成确定性check均通过。用户授权真实PG/SS运行门禁后置手动验收，因此最终交付结论保留相应Runtime unverified项。所有实际修改都在§5声明范围内，并在本次完成单次聚焦提交。

审阅入口：[策略与提交边界](#4-implementation-strategy-and-dependency-order)、[前置条件与澄清](#6-prerequisites-constraints-and-plan-clarifications)、[12个实施Step](#7-ordered-file-by-file-implementation-steps)、[质量门禁](#8-test-validation-and-quality-gates)。

当前按测试库可重建处理，删除历史数据保留、Flyway/manual接管、CRC/schema树和哨兵回填实现。仍保留空schema初始化后正常版本、checksum/route指纹、单库事务/多目标ready、LOCAL与tenant保护。六套旧迁移文件不可变；Agent只做原链上的空表纠正，Outbox/vector不移交。

文件清单列出实际需要写入的路径。既有PO只要继承新EgonModel即可获得字段，六套已正确的lombok.config直接复用，不制造空改动。PG/SS/真实主从需要后续显式隔离环境；文档PASS不代表这些测试已经执行。

## 2. Target Spec and Effective Design

### 2.1 Primary target

主目标：[主Spec](../spec/2026-09-12-21-11-mybatis-repository-cqrs-postgresql-evolution.md)。用户的`confirm`是明确批准证据，故批准metadata为Accepted；旧正文不被本Plan偷偷改写。用户随后明确同意测试数据可丢弃、完成后重建库，并调用执行Plan；单独的[修订](../spec/2026-09-13-07-42-mybatis-test-database-rebuild-amendment.md)据此记录为Accepted并限定其数据库运行边界。

主Spec在本轮锁定时全文快照为1120472 bytes、SHA256 `1b203d934af6dca9004be4a06194f40e21f014b413247080f3a39cd64699259a`；之后仅批准/Related Plans关系metadata更新。源代码基线commit不变。Plan不是先前工作已经完成的重复计划。

## 4. Implementation Strategy and Dependency Order

### 4.1 Ordered strategy

Step1/2不依赖六套生产业务，先建立公共纯路由和最小DDL能力。Step3切换EgonModel/API及其组件fixtures；Step4闭合完整装配/SQL/LOCAL门禁。Step5至10每次只适配一个完整family，包含domain接口、infrastructure仓储/SQL、initializer/config与必要调用方；Step11处理Agent。Step12在全体source已适配后才生成并验证。

Step3删除旧公共API后，尚未执行到的family可能暂时不能编译；这不是可提交状态。每步只申报相应已完成模块的GREEN，整个source/generated reactor到Step12才申报完成。当前清单没有跨Step重复写路径；Common测试fixture引用在Step3整体关闭，新增自动配置断言由Step4单独负责。

### 4.2 Test-first strategy

行为测试在相应实现前书写；缺新Java API时，允许先声明record/方法签名作为编译前置，不能把前置声明算功能GREEN。新实现文件明确分“签名/最小可编译壳→运行已写测试观察缺行为RED→同文件最小实现→GREEN”；SQL文件不同：不能创建空version文件，先写文本/PG契约测试，首次CREATE一次写完整SQL。环境缺失、下载失败、fixture配置错误都不算功能RED。

每个已有行为修改由当前可编译公开入口/元数据反射/SQL断言先得到RED；批量/LOCAL/DDL故障用实际结果和负面副作用断言，不仅检查注解。生成verifier先声明新合同，再从source生成验证，不手改generated产物。

### 4.4 Commit boundaries

遵循本次用户AGENTS规则，一个逻辑任务至多一个提交。12个Step是验证/回退里程碑，**不逐Step提交**；每步的Commit仅保留最终语义与归属声明，Step12满足门禁后对全部声明写路径做一次 `feat(mybatis): adopt repository CQRS and PostgreSQL sharding foundations` 提交。严禁git add -A或将无关dirty/untracked、target、.generated、凭据、运行输出混入。

如果真实PG/SS门禁未提供环境，报告具体未验证边界，不把skip作为成功或把Plan改Completed。代码提交与是否执行测试库重建是独立动作；不会在组件启动时隐式drop。

## 5. Change File Tree

每个写路径在此出现一次，§7按严格顺序展开；只读复用文件另列。目录归属遵循既有树，所有新文件由有效Spec授权的职责推导。相同文件若需后续再改，拥有Step与理由明确标记；没有多个Step并发写同一路径。

```text
Common MP: routing -> ddl -> model/Repository -> guards/autoconfigure -> tests/docs
source light -> light-open -> service -> service-open -> web -> web-open
Agent: knowledge Repo/SQL + original Flyway empty-table correction
closure: definitions/verifier/README -> source generation/check (ignored output) -> one final commit
```

## 6. Prerequisites, Constraints, and Plan Clarifications

- Execution clarification 2026-09-13：用户在真实PG/SS门禁后置问题后明确“继续迭代”。后续Step以源码、静态检查和本地单测为推进门禁；真实PG/SS测试移交用户手动执行，在最终审计持续标记未验证，不伪记PASS。仍不自动启动基础设施，仍按Step12一次最终提交。


### 6.1 Repository and worktree baseline

当前main commit如Header，生产代码没有dirty变化；主Spec、重建修订和本Plan为本任务文档。用户给出的AGENTS已读，仓库/父目录扫描没有额外AGENTS文件。保存用户后续任何dirty/untracked，不reset/clean/revert无关路径。

### 6.2 Build, test, and environment prerequisites

| Concern | Exact command/source | Required state | Validation boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Java | `java -version` | 本轮读取为Microsoft OpenJDK21.0.10，沿用Java21编译目标 | 仅版本读取已执行 |
| Maven | `./mvnw`，Common/Archetypes/source-projects POM | 使用仓库wrapper和受管版本；不升级依赖 | 本轮未构建 |
| Fast tests | 每Step完整-Dtest选择器+surefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false | -am前置模块可无目标测试，但目标模块必须实际运行命名测试 | 运行时RED/GREEN必须看目标reports |
| PG | `EGON_MP_PG_URL/EGON_MP_PG_USER/EGON_MP_PG_PASSWORD`，仅作为测试fixture读取的环境名 | 显式隔离schema/账号；执行门禁必须变量齐备且确认目标是可丢弃测试库 | 当前未连接，不打印变量值 |
| PG readwrite | family既有PRIMARY/REPLICA URL环境变量与隔离T4/B2拓扑 | 运维已建立真实PG复制，节点角色正确；不得用H2替代 | 显式PG/SS IT阶段 |
| Runtime ID | `egon.cola.component.id.machine-id` from `EGON_ID_MACHINE_ID` | 每运行实例唯一；test独立fixture可0；生产不得常量2001/本地counter | 配置/真实ID测试 |
| Generator | `bash scripts/generate_archetypes.sh generate` then `check` | 全部必要source本地artifact先可用；.generated保持ignored | 不发布Central、不启动服务 |

### 6.3 Immutable constraints and approved decisions

全部已有B/V/manual SQL不可改。首次代码升级目标为空schema，六套只新增各自一个完整初始化V20260913_001，Agent只新增一个空表纠正版本。新migration一次写完整后再验证；若内容设计发现重大变化回到Spec处理，不能把旧文件修checksum。只允许PG、LOCAL、现有ID算法、同tenant同库二级表和广播readonly规则。不得自动启动项目/DB/Docker/浏览器。

```java
  b=Long.remainderUnsigned(mix64(secondaryId XOR 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15),B)
  use only p.actualNodes[(t,b)], deduplicate and sort exact group/schema/table
  QUERY missing secondary may return current tenant slot B nodes within maxReadFanout; COMMAND requires bound keys; ROUTE_CANDIDATES only computes callback candidates

```

```java
List<EgonColaDdlResult> run(List<EgonColaDdlTargetBO> targets):
  validate all targets/resources/versions first; reject non-PG, replica or alias/schema/role duplication
  for each target: open Connection(autoCommit=false); lock schema using advisory transaction lock; re-read EMPTY/MANAGED/REJECT state
  EMPTY: execute full initial SQL; MANAGED: verify manifest prefix/checksum/route, skip equal versions and execute only later ones
  execute via ScriptUtils EOF separator; insert eight-field SQL history with PreparedStatement on same Connection; commit only after both succeed
  error -> rollback target, throw safe target/script/SQLState; bootstrap closes pools and never creates logical DS
  after all targets, verify required schema/replica/broadcast readiness; no default DdlApplicationRunner or auto DROP
```

```java
EgonColaIRepository<T> extends IRepository<T>; EgonColaRepository<M,T> extends AbstractRepository<M,T>:

  executeMybatisBatch(entities,size,method) validates entire bounded input then invokes actual MybatisBatch on one Spring-managed transaction
  interpret updateCounts not group count; reject -2 for version-conditioned writes, preserve insert unknown count; second chunk/outer failure rolls back
  no old IService/AR shim; retain single-call false/missing semantics and no automatic retry of unknown commands
```

```java
  @TestBean(name="dataSource",methodName="createFastDataSource",enforceOverride=true) DataSource fastTestDataSource
  static createFastDataSource(): DriverManagerDataSource jdbc:h2:mem:unique_UUID;MODE=PostgreSQL;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1, load classpath:mybatis/h2-schema.sql
  @TestBean(name="egonColaWriteTargetResolver",methodName="createFastResolver",enforceOverride=true) resolver returns one test/PUBLIC target for any registered logical table
  @TestBean(name="snowflakeIdGenerator",methodName="createFastIds") LongIdGenerator uses local AtomicLong starting100000; this is not the production generator
  inherited @TestPropertySource sets Common ddl.enabled=false and spring.sql.init.mode=never; @DirtiesContext(AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD) prevents sharing data/IDs
  @AfterEach shuts down only the generated in-memory H2 through fastTestDataSource; never touch a configured PG URL
  real PG/SS integration classes must not inherit these overrides
```

```java
  @TestBean(name="dataSource",methodName="createFastDataSource",enforceOverride=true) DataSource fastTestDataSource
  static createFastDataSource(): DriverManagerDataSource jdbc:h2:mem:unique_UUID;MODE=PostgreSQL;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1, load classpath:mybatis/h2-schema.sql
  @TestBean(name="egonColaWriteTargetResolver",methodName="createFastResolver",enforceOverride=true) resolver returns one test/PUBLIC target for any registered logical table
  @TestBean(name="snowflakeIdGenerator",methodName="createFastIds") LongIdGenerator uses local AtomicLong starting100000; this is not the production generator
  inherited @TestPropertySource sets Common ddl.enabled=false and spring.sql.init.mode=never; @DirtiesContext(AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD) prevents sharing data/IDs
  @AfterEach shuts down only the generated in-memory H2 through fastTestDataSource; never touch a configured PG URL
  real PG/SS integration classes must not inherit these overrides
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```yaml
YAML sharding-readwrite.yml in light-open:
  six-family modes remove flyway target keys and bind ddl target alias/schema/role/manifest; production uses PG DDL, default test profile sets ddl.enabled=false with explicit H2 test overrides
  Agent keeps original Flyway ownership and sets Common ddl.enabled=false; real PG/SS integration explicitly activates the production-style initializer
  preserve existing connection env names and tenant/user provider keys; bind egon.cola.component.id.enabled=true, machine-id from EGON_ID_MACHINE_ID, max-clock-backward=PT0.005S
  test profile alone may use machine-id=0 for isolated fixtures; real PG/uniqueness tests use an explicit real generator, not a constant2001 fixture; add no hardcoded secret
  synchronize base/dev/test/prod core keys for DDL durations,local guard,page/batch limits and dynamic whitelist
  dev alone enables safe recorder/IllegalSQL; dev+prod fails, raw recorder subclass logger YAML value quoted 'OFF' with separate safe summary topic
  declare mapper-locations including new explicit XML resources and preserve all unrelated transport/security/frontend keys
```

- Verification contribution: 本Step列出的focused gate及对应Spec TEST断言。

- Implementation pseudocode:

```yaml

  six-family modes remove flyway target keys and bind ddl target alias/schema/role/manifest; production uses PG DDL, default test profile sets ddl.enabled=false with explicit H2 test overrides
  Agent keeps original Flyway ownership and sets Common ddl.enabled=false; real PG/SS integration explicitly activates the production-style initializer
  preserve existing connection env names and tenant/user provider keys; bind egon.cola.component.id.enabled=true, machine-id from EGON_ID_MACHINE_ID, max-clock-backward=PT0.005S
  test profile alone may use machine-id=0 for isolated fixtures; real PG/uniqueness tests use an explicit real generator, not a constant2001 fixture; add no hardcoded secret
  synchronize base/dev/test/prod core keys for DDL durations,local guard,page/batch limits and dynamic whitelist
  dev alone enables safe recorder/IllegalSQL; dev+prod fails, raw recorder subclass logger YAML value quoted 'OFF' with separate safe summary topic
  declare mapper-locations including new explicit XML resources and preserve all unrelated transport/security/frontend keys
```

```java
  @TestBean(name="egonColaWriteTargetResolver",methodName="createFastResolver",enforceOverride=true) resolver returns one test/PUBLIC target for any registered logical table
  @TestBean(name="snowflakeIdGenerator",methodName="createFastIds") LongIdGenerator uses local AtomicLong starting100000; this is not the production generator
  inherited @TestPropertySource sets Common ddl.enabled=false and spring.sql.init.mode=never; @DirtiesContext(AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD) prevents sharing data/IDs
  @AfterEach shuts down only the generated in-memory H2 through fastTestDataSource; never touch a configured PG URL
  real PG/SS integration classes must not inherit these overrides
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```yaml
YAML sharding.yml in service:
  six-family modes remove flyway target keys and bind ddl target alias/schema/role/manifest; production uses PG DDL, default test profile sets ddl.enabled=false with explicit H2 test overrides
  Agent keeps original Flyway ownership and sets Common ddl.enabled=false; real PG/SS integration explicitly activates the production-style initializer
  preserve existing connection env names and tenant/user provider keys; bind egon.cola.component.id.enabled=true, machine-id from EGON_ID_MACHINE_ID, max-clock-backward=PT0.005S
  test profile alone may use machine-id=0 for isolated fixtures; real PG/uniqueness tests use an explicit real generator, not a constant2001 fixture; add no hardcoded secret
  synchronize base/dev/test/prod core keys for DDL durations,local guard,page/batch limits and dynamic whitelist
  dev alone enables safe recorder/IllegalSQL; dev+prod fails, raw recorder subclass logger YAML value quoted 'OFF' with separate safe summary topic
  declare mapper-locations including new explicit XML resources and preserve all unrelated transport/security/frontend keys
```

```java
  @TestBean(name="dataSource",methodName="createFastDataSource",enforceOverride=true) DataSource fastTestDataSource

  @TestBean(name="egonColaWriteTargetResolver",methodName="createFastResolver",enforceOverride=true) resolver returns one test/PUBLIC target for any registered logical table
  @TestBean(name="snowflakeIdGenerator",methodName="createFastIds") LongIdGenerator uses local AtomicLong starting100000; this is not the production generator
  inherited @TestPropertySource sets Common ddl.enabled=false and spring.sql.init.mode=never; @DirtiesContext(AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD) prevents sharing data/IDs
  @AfterEach shuts down only the generated in-memory H2 through fastTestDataSource; never touch a configured PG URL
  real PG/SS integration classes must not inherit these overrides
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```yaml
YAML sharding.yml in service-open:
  six-family modes remove flyway target keys and bind ddl target alias/schema/role/manifest; production uses PG DDL, default test profile sets ddl.enabled=false with explicit H2 test overrides
  Agent keeps original Flyway ownership and sets Common ddl.enabled=false; real PG/SS integration explicitly activates the production-style initializer
  preserve existing connection env names and tenant/user provider keys; bind egon.cola.component.id.enabled=true, machine-id from EGON_ID_MACHINE_ID, max-clock-backward=PT0.005S
  test profile alone may use machine-id=0 for isolated fixtures; real PG/uniqueness tests use an explicit real generator, not a constant2001 fixture; add no hardcoded secret
  synchronize base/dev/test/prod core keys for DDL durations,local guard,page/batch limits and dynamic whitelist
  dev alone enables safe recorder/IllegalSQL; dev+prod fails, raw recorder subclass logger YAML value quoted 'OFF' with separate safe summary topic
  declare mapper-locations including new explicit XML resources and preserve all unrelated transport/security/frontend keys
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```yaml
YAML sharding.yml in web:
  six-family modes remove flyway target keys and bind ddl target alias/schema/role/manifest; production uses PG DDL, default test profile sets ddl.enabled=false with explicit H2 test overrides
  Agent keeps original Flyway ownership and sets Common ddl.enabled=false; real PG/SS integration explicitly activates the production-style initializer
  preserve existing connection env names and tenant/user provider keys; bind egon.cola.component.id.enabled=true, machine-id from EGON_ID_MACHINE_ID, max-clock-backward=PT0.005S
  test profile alone may use machine-id=0 for isolated fixtures; real PG/uniqueness tests use an explicit real generator, not a constant2001 fixture; add no hardcoded secret
  synchronize base/dev/test/prod core keys for DDL durations,local guard,page/batch limits and dynamic whitelist
  dev alone enables safe recorder/IllegalSQL; dev+prod fails, raw recorder subclass logger YAML value quoted 'OFF' with separate safe summary topic
  declare mapper-locations including new explicit XML resources and preserve all unrelated transport/security/frontend keys
```

```java
abstract class PersistenceTestSupport uses Spring6.2 @TestBean overrides:
  @TestBean(name="dataSource",methodName="createFastDataSource",enforceOverride=true) DataSource fastTestDataSource
  static createFastDataSource(): DriverManagerDataSource jdbc:h2:mem:unique_UUID;MODE=PostgreSQL;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1, load classpath:mybatis/h2-schema.sql
  @TestBean(name="egonColaWriteTargetResolver",methodName="createFastResolver",enforceOverride=true) resolver returns one test/PUBLIC target for any registered logical table
  @TestBean(name="snowflakeIdGenerator",methodName="createFastIds") LongIdGenerator uses local AtomicLong starting100000; this is not the production generator
  inherited @TestPropertySource sets Common ddl.enabled=false and spring.sql.init.mode=never; @DirtiesContext(AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD) prevents sharing data/IDs
  @AfterEach shuts down only the generated in-memory H2 through fastTestDataSource; never touch a configured PG URL
  real PG/SS integration classes must not inherit these overrides
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```yaml
YAML sharding.yml in web-open:
  six-family modes remove flyway target keys and bind ddl target alias/schema/role/manifest; production uses PG DDL, default test profile sets ddl.enabled=false with explicit H2 test overrides
  Agent keeps original Flyway ownership and sets Common ddl.enabled=false; real PG/SS integration explicitly activates the production-style initializer
  preserve existing connection env names and tenant/user provider keys; bind egon.cola.component.id.enabled=true, machine-id from EGON_ID_MACHINE_ID, max-clock-backward=PT0.005S
  test profile alone may use machine-id=0 for isolated fixtures; real PG/uniqueness tests use an explicit real generator, not a constant2001 fixture; add no hardcoded secret
  synchronize base/dev/test/prod core keys for DDL durations,local guard,page/batch limits and dynamic whitelist
  dev alone enables safe recorder/IllegalSQL; dev+prod fails, raw recorder subclass logger YAML value quoted 'OFF' with separate safe summary topic
  declare mapper-locations including new explicit XML resources and preserve all unrelated transport/security/frontend keys
```

```yaml
  dev alone enables safe recorder/IllegalSQL; dev+prod fails, raw recorder subclass logger YAML value quoted 'OFF' with separate safe summary topic
  declare mapper-locations including new explicit XML resources and preserve all unrelated transport/security/frontend keys
```

```xml
</mapper>
```

## 9. Migration, Compatibility, Rollout, and Rollback

按重建修订：当前数据全是测试数据，可丢弃。完成代码/生成验证后，明确每个测试PRIMARY的数据库/schema清单和其副本关系，停止测试旧binary写入，再受控重建该目标；不根据模糊默认URL猜测目标，不在本Plan写入一条自动drop命令。随后六套新初始化SQL建立最终表结构和八列history，全部target/replica schema就绪后才由用户启动应用。数据库服务本身由用户控制。

每family只有一个新V20260913_001，DDL先于SS logical元数据装载。旧B/V/manual资源保留原字节；六套不执行其旧链。Agent原FlywayV001/V002后新纠正仅对空knowledge表执行，Outbox/vector仍原所有权。空库/managed之外状态REBUILD_REQUIRED；无data backfill、CRC、BASELINE、ADOPTED或哨兵。

代码和schema允许不兼容，无IService/AR/boolean shim；外部wire结构不变。回退测试环境可以再次重建并使用上一份可用artifact，不要求恢复无价值测试行；管理history/route不匹配不能通过改旧SQL或repair强行放过。当前legacy分片地址不改，未来真实表启用两级profile仍要独立场景记录/显式重建或迁移，不由本任务自动再均衡。

当前没有必须再次询问用户的设计问题。运行环境可用性是实施门禁前置，不是把Plan写成未定设计；但它不能被忽略后宣称最终完整验收。

## 12. Review and Acceptance

### 12.1 Original requirement fidelity

主Spec37条与重建修订5条均出现在Steps及trace表，约束/排除项不变。新增前提通过独立Spec修订而不是Plan暗改。保留SQL、tenant、version、ID、LOCAL、两级、broadcast和读写分离的必要测试。

### 12.2 Spec consistency

完整设计沿用已批准主Spec，历史兼容依用户新前提移除。PCL条目只解决实际目录、无操作文件、测试fixture、Java编译前置、MapStruct/Bean落地和必要PG测试依赖；不添加业务API、层、缓存、消息平台或新ID算法。PO源码无必要修改时复用，不机械扩大写面。

### 12.3 Repository executability

每个Step有严序路径、当前source哈希/存在性、符号、输入输出/异常、伪代码、测试贡献、中间状态、cwd和commit路径。source资源实际位于哪个module按当前扫描列出；共享文件重复编辑理由明确。所有旧SQL不在Modify/Delete清单，生成文件由脚本管理且不提交。

### 12.4 Test and release completeness

RED/签名前置/GREEN、fast/PG/SS/replica/generated分开；不会把本轮文档检查或future命令写成测试已经通过。一次最终提交避免不兼容中间态被当成可交付版本；用户自行启动runtime，重建在明确测试目标后受控进行。

#### Execution clarification EC-001 — 原始乐观锁版本绑定

MP3.5.16 `OptimisticLockerInnerInterceptor.doOptimisticLocker` 对带et的自定义UPDATE同样执行：保存 `MP_OPTLOCK_VERSION_ORIGINAL`，再把entity.version加1；并不只处理updateById。已用本机3.5.16 jar的javap及H2失败/成功回归核实。因此主Spec§7.3.3中的示例XML比较值实现为 `version=#{MP_OPTLOCK_VERSION_ORIGINAL}`，SET仍为version=version+1，Java签名和调用者expectedVersion完全不变。这是适配真实MP参数生命周期，避免比较新版本；后续每个具体XML使用同一绑定，未增加新接口、表或版本。

EgonColaMetaObjectHandler在原final userIdProvider字段上增加Lombok getter，供Batch通过当前factory的真实handler捕获可替换Provider的user快照；不从MDC硬取或另设Provider。after hooks仅允许非技术字段，比较技术快照拒绝越权。

- 静态检查：58张物理业务表拥有完整技术字段和NOT NULL约束；6个manifest SHA匹配；31份历史SQL hash不变；两个家族边界脚本通过；未声明改动清单为空，generated tracked为0。最终生成/commit证据待后续补录。
